turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That works out well. Did you two manage to get any rock climbing in this week, or has it been too hectic?

turns.text: That's great. Have you had any time for your guitar lately, or is climbing taking up most of your free time?

turns.text: I've been playing a little bit in the evenings. It's a nice way to unwind. I'm trying to learn a new acoustic song, slowly but surely.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a perfect way to relax. By the way, how are Ana and her husband doing since the wedding in San Antonio?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: They're doing great! Really enjoying married life. I actually need to call her sometime this week to catch up, but right now I should probably get back to these client accounts.
